decisions.reason: Its two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's existing plural-component and injection equipment knowledge, so the firm can readily assimilate and improve it.
Similarly closely related to the firm's core plural-component and injection expertise, making early results interpretable and continued development likely.
Automatic airless spray guns fit the firm's existing spray gun and application technology, allowing effective learning and commercial application.
